evaluate_segmentation_masks: evaluate segmentation mask results against a COCO json dataset and return COCOeval metrics
evaluate_bounding_boxes: evaluate bounding box detection results against a COCO json dataset and return COCOeval metrics
evaluate_box_proposals: evaluate detection proposal recall metrics for a roidb across configurable area ranges and IoU thresholds
evaluate_keypoints: evaluate keypoint detection results against a COCO json dataset and return COCOeval metrics
evaluate_body_uv: evaluate DensePose body UV map results against a COCO json dataset and return COCOeval metrics
